_readme: Local catalogue overlay. Copy this file to src/catalog/catalog.local.json (gitignored) and put your real values here. Merge rules: entityMaps.<key>, clientHashIdentities, roles and hosts are replaced wholesale; questions.<id> overrides apply field by field (e.g. point q-hottest-rooms at your own sensor entity ids). Never commit the populated file.
